jobs: hand a card header to its host
pick the header title and icon by kind
add a pull request chip to the header
attach an answer button for merge and documentation
summary: Does nothing unless the host has a header callback and a question is loaded. Decision headers get no answer button, since their answers are buttons inside the card; merge and documentation headers do, and the pull request chip shows only the number.

jobs: list the answer choices for a question
put the recommended answer first
offer a message-only choice for merges
summary: Returns a list of choice objects, each with a label, icon, tone and hint. Merge questions get two fixed choices, approve or message instead; other questions get one choice per option, with the recommended option moved to the front and marked.

jobs: build the answer button once
wire the button's click handler
paint the button to its current state
summary: Creates the answer button on first call and returns the same element after that. The click handler is attached through the onclick helper, and the button is painted from the current state straight away.

jobs: stop the click from reaching parent elements
open the review page for documentation questions
ignore clicks on a settled or busy question
toggle the choice list beside the button
summary: Takes the click event and returns nothing. Documentation questions open the review page in a new window; other questions ignore the click when answered, closed or sending, close the open choice list if there is one, and otherwise open it just below the button within the screen width.

jobs: paint the answer button to its state
show a spinner while the answer is sending
set the button's tooltip and label
summary: Does nothing until the button exists. While sending it shows a spinner; once answered it turns green for any answer other than a message, which shows a faded chat icon, and an unanswered question shows an outline check, or for documentation a pencil icon and a label pointing to the review page.

jobs: close the choice list
focus the message box for a message choice
send the chosen answer right away
summary: Takes one choice object and returns nothing. A message choice only moves focus to the message box and scrolls it into view; any other choice is sent at once.

jobs: load the swipe deck component if missing
open the question's materials as a deck
start the deck at the current material
nest the deck under any deck already open
summary: Takes no input and returns nothing, and does nothing if the component or the materials are missing. A deck opened on its own is titled after the current material and its subtitle names the kind of question and the pull request; moving between materials keeps the title and icon in step.

jobs: fill one slide with a material's content
show notes as bold questions with asides
embed an HTML material in a sandboxed frame
load a material's stored markup when missing
summary: Takes a material's position and its slide element and appends the content to the slide. Notes show each question in bold with its aside, an adjustment shows a fixed line pointing to the question's own deck, HTML materials go into a sandboxed frame, and other materials show stored markup, fetched first if not yet loaded.

jobs: toggle the pull request panel open or shut
load the panel component on first open
place the panel under its chip
summary: Takes the chip element and returns nothing. Closes the panel if it is open; otherwise, on first open it loads the panel component and wires outside clicks to close it, except clicks on the chip, then places the panel below the chip, kept on screen, at 480 pixels wide from 768 pixels up and 360 below.

jobs: build the link to the review page
return an empty link for other questions
summary: Returns a string and takes no input. For documentation questions it is a link to the review page, carrying the question's file and the repo, ref and path where the question is stored; for any other question it is an empty string.

jobs: fetch the saved answers from the repository
parse the answers file one line at a time
skip lines that are not valid JSON
summary: Takes no input and returns nothing; it sets the answers list. It reads a fresh copy of the file, drops blank lines and lines that do not parse, and leaves the list empty rather than raising an error when the fetch fails.

jobs: post the chosen answer to the repository
require a note for an adjust answer
add the posted answer to the local list
reset the form after a successful send
report a failed send to the form
summary: Takes the form's pick and note and returns nothing; it does nothing if no answer is picked or a send is running, and an adjust answer needs a note. The entry is posted to the answers file, and to the pull request as a comment when that option is on; success resets the form and tells the host, while failure shows an error and keeps the pick.

jobs: find the panel nearest the row's left edge
hold the index during a programmatic move
set the current index from the scroll position
summary: Takes no input and returns nothing; it reads the panel row's scroll position and updates the current index. While a programmatic move is in flight, positions other than its target are ignored; reaching the target ends the move and runs the arrival step.

jobs: clamp an index into the valid range
scroll the panel row smoothly to a panel
finish the move on arrival or timeout
summary: Takes a panel index and returns nothing. The index is clamped to the materials, and nothing happens when there are none. The move counts as in flight until the row reaches the panel or 900 milliseconds pass; if the row is already in place the move finishes at once, and otherwise the timeout reads the position back and runs the arrival step.
